skills.name: govcon-agency-account-plan
skills.description: Choose specific government buying offices and build an evidence-backed sales account plan. Use when selecting agencies, components or offices to pursue.

skills.name: govcon-amendment-review
skills.description: Compare government solicitation amendments and identify response-planning changes. Use when a revised package, new attachment or Q&A may affect a pursuit.

skills.name: govcon-bid-decision
skills.description: Prepare an evidence-based pursue, hold or stop recommendation for a government opportunity. Use for a management decision rather than autonomous bidding.

skills.name: govcon-buyer-meeting-prep
skills.description: Prepare a government sales meeting around the buyer mission, documented evidence and decision-changing questions. Use for a planned meeting or discovery discussion.

skills.name: govcon-capture-plan
skills.description: Draft a government contracting capture plan with customer questions, company proof, competitive hypotheses and next actions. Use after a pursuit is selected for research.

skills.name: govcon-company-brief
skills.description: Turn company capabilities and evidence into reusable government contracting research context. Use before finding work or defining a target market.

skills.name: govcon-company-diligence
skills.description: Resolve a government contractor and examine supported capabilities, classifications and public claims. Use for partner, competitor or account diligence.

skills.name: govcon-crm-follow-up
skills.description: Turn actual government sales notes into a follow-up draft and specifically requested G2X CRM changes. Use after real interactions or for an explicit planned next step.

skills.name: govcon-forecast-research
skills.description: Turn public acquisition forecasts into earlier business development research leads. Use to investigate planned buying before a current solicitation is established.

skills.name: govcon-incumbent-research
skills.description: Build a sourced incumbent or competitor brief from company and award evidence. Use before a pursuit decision or competitive planning discussion.

skills.name: govcon-industry-day-prep
skills.description: Research a government industry day and prepare an attendance decision and useful questions. Use for event preparation, not automatic registration.

skills.name: govcon-labor-rate-research
skills.description: Compare published labor-rate references for government contracting research. Use for category comparisons and reference analysis, not to set a bid price.

skills.name: govcon-market-research
skills.description: Define and research a government contracting market using consistent award measures and scope. Use for market sizing, segment comparisons and buyer concentration.

skills.name: govcon-opportunity-discovery
skills.description: Find and screen government opportunities against company capabilities and constraints. Use for an initial shortlist rather than a final bid decision.

skills.name: govcon-pipeline-review
skills.description: Review a government contracting pipeline and prepare decisions, owners and next actions. Use for a dated pursuit review or a draft cleanup plan.

skills.name: govcon-recompete-research
skills.description: Research expiring awards and potential follow-on opportunities for forward capture planning. Use for a recompete watch or early pursuit research.

skills.name: govcon-requirements-review
skills.description: Read a government solicitation package and build a cited requirements working list. Use before proposal planning or a company-fit assessment.

skills.name: govcon-research-handoff
skills.description: Turn government contracting research into a sourced brief and requested G2X handoff. Use when a teammate needs the evidence, decision and next action together.

skills.name: govcon-response-outline
skills.description: Build a government proposal response outline from the actual solicitation instructions and evaluation criteria. Use to plan sections and supporting evidence.

skills.name: govcon-sled-discovery
skills.description: Research state, local and education procurement opportunities across supported records and source portals. Use when the target market is SLED rather than federal notices.

skills.name: govcon-supply-item-research
skills.description: Research government supply items, NSNs and supplier evidence. Use for defense supply opportunity research when identifiers and item relationships matter.

skills.name: govcon-teaming-partners
skills.description: Find complementary government contracting teaming candidates and prepare diligence. Use when filling a specific capability, experience, capacity or route-to-market gap.

skills.name: govcon-vehicle-strategy
skills.description: Research a government contract vehicle and potential routes to market. Use when checking holders, relevant use or prime/subcontract pathways.

skills.name: govcon-watchlist-management
skills.description: Create or review specifically requested government contracting watchlists and saved searches. Use to keep a defined research scope available in G2X.

skills.name: government-contracting
skills.description: Government contracting sales, business development and capture with G2X intelligence through GovCon MCP. Use for market and account research, opportunity development, teaming, solicitation review, capture and pursuit follow-through; choose focused workflow skills when installed.
